mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bookId,b.title AS bookTitle,c.name AS categoryName,COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON b.id=br.book_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id=b.category_id WHERE br.status IN ('BORROWING','RETURNED') GROUP BY b.id,b.title,c.name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC,b.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.name AS categoryName,COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN br.status='BORROWING' AND DATE(br.due_time)<DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN book b ON b.category_id=c.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON br.book_id=b.id AND br.status IN ('BORROWING','RETURNED') GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC,c.id ASC
